altText: A Blue Jay perched side-on with its crest raised, bright blue above and white below, with a black necklace across the throat.
A Blue Jay standing at the edge of a bird bath, seen from the side against green ferns.
A Blue Jay facing forward at a feeder, showing the black necklace and the pattern on its face.
A Blue Jay flying with its wings spread, showing the black bars and white patches across the blue.
